title: OpenClaw vs IFTTT vs Zapier for Personal Automation: Why AI Agents Win
summary: OpenClaw vs IFTTT vs Zapier compared for personal automation. If-then rules can't adapt to context. OpenClaw reasons about your day. Here's the real difference for morning briefings, email triage, and habit tracking.
body_markdown: Zapier Agents lets you configure AI behaviors within pre-defined triggers and action sets — the AI fills in values inside a workflow you designed. OpenClaw reasons from first principles about what to do in an open-ended situation. The difference is clearest in personal tasks: "manage my email today" is a single OpenClaw instruction; in Zapier, you'd need to pre-define every email scenario before the agent could act.[Blink Claw](https://blink.new/claw) gives you a fully managed OpenClaw instance from about $45/month per agent with 13 AI models.
